title: Columbia, SC — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Columbia, SC: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Columbia is a city in SC with a population of 136,632. Capital city with USC Gamecocks, three rivers, and affordable Southern living. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.7.
